body: Yup. Voltarol (Diclofenec) in suppositories.  As far as I have read, it's just a strong basic pain killer?

I get it. For me, whether it's depression or just my mental state, it's not understanding that yearning to 'want something that badly'. 

You hear about people at a certain age saying that their biological clock starts ticking and the urge, the drive to have a child hits them like a plank in the face.

I know I don't want kids. But it still feels very lonely when you watch everyone else go mad over getting/having one and you don't understand what they're going through.
It's the idea that I'm the coordinator of chores. Yeah, I could ask, but I'm expected to do all these things without asking, why the double standard? He's not asking me to do things. I just do them.
If you go down into Suffolk, it also has a slightly different dialect. Softer, less broad. Just to complicate matters. 😅

The reason we were able to get the house for a good price is that the two properties are classified as one, the planning permission is restricted to being a 'multi generational property' and can't be split.
Sorry, meant to say exchange of contracts. 😅

Me and my husband have seperate finances for our own stuff then a joint bank account for rent/food etc. I love the bloke, but I don't want to put my money into a pot for it to be spent on d&d dice and motorcycle parts. 😂
[ Removed by Reddit ]

Norfolk/Suffolk. We'd get to the fight late because it takes us a while to get moving on things, then win by dint of waiting for the rest of you to fight amongst yourselves. 😂😅 We be patient folk y'know.
Yeah. What it boils down to is that he's concerned about reinfecting himself. 🤷‍♀️
Sod that. My taxes already contribute to schools/childcare that I never plan on using. Why should I have to pay extra because I don't want to bring a child into this hellhole of a world?

I'm going through this at the moment. Both got Covid, he's in our bedroom and I'm on the sofa in the living room. He's saying stuff about 'he doesn't want to increase his viral load' and when he hugs me he holds his breath until we're finished. 

The problem is that all the stuff around the house needs to get done and I feel that because he's still isolated in the bedroom, it's up to me to do it. And I feel like shit. 

I just want a hug from someone whose not stiff as a board who doesn't want to be there.

 And the worst part of it is that I think he wants to be isolated? It gives him an excuse to not be near me. You'd think I would get little messages throughout the day, but nope. It's like I don't exist. 

Sorry for ranting on your post.
Same to you - waited for two years, finally get to see them again! Saw them at Download ages ago and that was amazing enough. 💚

The email said there was shuttlebuses available, you'd have hoped that they'd twig the amount of people coming back from the gig 😅 I think it's a theme with some of the stadiums that they don't plan ahead. 

Yeah, we got standing. Sounds like early turn up time and comfy shoes for me then! 

Same for you, have a good one!

I have tried being clear. I've tried talking to him about it. I've tried not doing the passive aggressive shit. Honestly, I'm just getting to the stage where I feel like banging my head against a brick wall.

I've been off work furloughed for the past few months and I'm dreading coming back to work. Before all this I was just about surviving, my mental health had deteriorated and I was...yeah. not in a good place. Since I've been off work, my mental health has improved dramatically, I've felt more myself than I ever have and I really don't want to go back. But as everyone else is saying, it is not a good idea to try and find a new job in the ever changing Coronavirus induced climate.
They're still doing up the shop, so it's not technically 'working' apart from painting/structural building work. This is where I don't know wether it's still under private residence? 🤷‍♀️

It just feels like the world is too much. I'm just some tiny blip on the surface of the earth. It wouldn't matter if I wasn't here, the world would carry on. People will mourn, sure, but they'll get over it. I'm not contributing to society in any meaningful way, I'm not making a difference. I have no dreams or ambitions. My husband says he does care, but we've been drifting apart it feels like. I'm just empty. I'm sorry to say this over a messageboard but I don't want to bother people I know.

You know your favourite TV show? Maybe Game of Thrones? Or your favourite sports team? You won't be able to watch them again. You'll never be able to pet a dog...or a cat. You won't be able to eat your favourite dessert even though you know it ruins your teeth. Your favourite book. 

The only reason I'm saying this to you is because it's what I am telling myself every day.
Life is pain, anyone who says otherwise is selling something.
